notes: A competing reading would put *are* on the `לְ` under rule 43 and leave `הָיָה` unrepresented; the accepted alignment keeps the copula on the written verb, since `הָיָה` is present and rule 43's first clause gives the recasting to it. That is defensible and the note names the alternative.
`בָמוֹת עוֹלָם` is rendered attributively (*ancient high places*), so rule 28 governs and `בָּמָה` heads on *high* under rule 31.
